input: Build a command-line TODO app. Create /app/todo.sh that supports these subcommands: 'add <task>' appends a task to /app/tasks.txt, 'list' prints all tasks with line numbers, 'done <number>' removes that line from the file. Then demonstrate: add 'Buy groceries', add 'Write tests', add 'Deploy app', list all tasks, mark task 1 as done, list again to show remaining tasks.

transcript.final_response:
Created executable `/app/todo.sh` supporting:
- `add <task>`
- `list`
- `done <number>`

Ran the requested demonstration:

```console
$ /app/todo.sh add 'Buy groceries'
$ /app/todo.sh add 'Write tests'
$ /app/todo.sh add 'Deploy app'
$ /app/todo.sh list
1. Buy groceries
2. Write tests
3. Deploy app

$ /app/todo.sh done 1
$ /app/todo.sh list
1. Write tests
2. Deploy app
```

The remaining tasks are saved in `/app/tasks.txt`.
tool_calls:
mkdir -p /app
cat > /app/todo.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TASK_FILE=/app/tasks.txt
usage() {
  echo "Usage: $0 {add <task>|list|done <number>}" >&2
  exit 1
}

[[ $# -ge 1 ]] || usage
command=$1
shift
case "$command" in
  add)
    [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || usage
    task="$*"
    [[ -n "$task" && "$task" != *$'\n'* ]] || { echo 'Task must be nonempty and on one line.' >&2; exit 1; }
    printf '%s\n' "$task" >> "$TASK_FILE"
    ;;
  list)
    [[ $# -eq 0 ]] || usage
    if [[ -f "$TASK_FILE" ]]; then
      awk '{printf "%d. %s\n", NR, $0}' "$TASK_FILE"
    fi
    ;;
  done)
    [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || usage
    [[ "$1" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo 'Task number must be a positive integer.' >&2; exit 1; }
    [[ -f "$TASK_FILE" ]] || { echo 'No tasks found.' >&2; exit 1; }
    awk -v number="$1" 'END {exit !(number <= NR)}' "$TASK_FILE" || { echo 'Task number out of range.' >&2; exit 1; }
    temp=$(mktemp /app/tasks.txt.XXXXXX)
    trap 'rm -f "$temp"' EXIT
    awk -v number="$1" 'NR != number' "$TASK_FILE" > "$temp"
    mv "$temp" "$TASK_FILE"
    ;;
  *) usage ;;
esac
EOF
chmod +x /app/todo.sh
/app/todo.sh add 'Buy groceries'
/app/todo.sh add 'Write tests'
/app/todo.sh add 'Deploy app'
printf 'All tasks:\n'
/app/todo.sh list
printf '\nMarking task 1 as done...\n'
/app/todo.sh done 1
printf '\nRemaining tasks:\n'
/app/todo.sh list
cat /app/tasks.txt
